KEYCLOAK_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install keycloak. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

KEYCLOAK_VERSION.description: Specific version of keycloak to install.

KEYCLOAK_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading keycloak binary or archive artifacts.
